name: Adobe Experience Manager (Cloud Manager) Orchestrator
description: The Adobe Experience Manager (Cloud Manager) Universal Orchestrator extension manages customer-managed (OV/EV) TLS/SSL certificates on Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service via the Adobe Cloud Manager API, supporting inventory, enrollment, removal, and discovery.

store_types.Name: Adobe Experience Manager Cloud Manager
store_types.ClientMachineDescription: The Adobe Cloud Manager API base URL. Enter 'https://cloudmanager.adobe.io'.
store_types.StorePathDescription: The numeric Cloud Manager program identifier (programId) that this store manages; for example, '12345'. One store maps to one program.

Properties.Name: ImsOrgId
Properties.Description: The Adobe IMS Organization ID (e.g. 'XXXXXXXX@AdobeOrg'), sent as the 'x-gw-ims-org-id' header on Cloud Manager API requests. This is an identifier, not a credential.

Properties.Name: ImsTokenUrl
Properties.Description: The Adobe IMS OAuth Server-to-Server token endpoint used to obtain access tokens.

Properties.Name: ImsScopes
Properties.Description: Comma-separated IMS scopes requested for the access token.
